text: Fixed. The issue was in `flags/parse.py`: `parse_flag` lowercased the input but never stripped it, so `"off "` (with a trailing space) didn't match the `_FALSE_WORDS` set and was treated as true. The one-line fix `word = text.lower().strip()` makes the behavior match the documented contract (case-insensitive, ignores surrounding whitespace, raises `ValueError` on empty/whitespace-only input). All existing tests pass, and the reported case plus related edge cases (leading/trailing spaces, mixed case, whitespace-only input) now behave correctly.
